findings.description: The auth cases return a status object, then immediately hit another return with shop props. Delete the orphaned shop return statement so settings pages receive correct props.

Add five mappings to matchPathToComponent: /forgot-password → auth/ForgotPassword, /password/reset → auth/ResetPassword, /user/confirm-password → auth/ConfirmPassword, /verify-email → auth/VerifyEmail, /password/otp/verify → auth/VerifyOtp.

The commit message claims api.ts was enhanced with 50–200ms delays and error simulation, but the features already existed from commit 838850a. Correct the commit message to reflect what was actually implemented in this PR.
/password/reset/{token} parameterized path not handled; auth fallback returns Dashboard instead of appropriate auth page.
